description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'NotesTestingUtil' for testing purposes within the Nextcloud Notes Android client project. It includes methods for observing LiveData values and mocking SingleSignOnAccount objects using SharedPreferences.

classes.name: NotesTestingUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for testing LiveData and mocking SingleSignOnAccount objects in the Android environment.

methods.name: getOrAwaitValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value from a LiveData object, waiting up to 2 seconds for it to be set, or throws an exception if not set.

methods.name: mockSingleSignOn
methods.description: Mocks a SingleSignOnAccount by storing its string representation in SharedPreferences and configuring the AccountImporter to use this SharedPreferences instance.
